title: Kitchen Remodeling Marketing
html:
Kitchen Remodeling Marketing Services

Each channel feeds the same goal: more booked design consultations. Want the playbook first? Read how to get kitchen remodeling leads.

  • SEO

  • Google Ads

  • Meta Ads

  • Websites

Get to the top of Google’s search results this week with targeted Google Ads campaigns .

Most homeowners plan a kitchen remodel for months before they call. Meta Ads keep your finished kitchens in their Facebook and Instagram feeds while they plan, with photo and video ads targeted to homeowners in your service area.

How We Bring in Higher-Value Kitchen Projects

More leads don't help if they're all asking for the cheapest quote.

Attract High-Value Kitchen Remodeling Clients

That pulls in homeowners planning full remodels and filters out quick-quote shoppers.

Own the Upscale Kitchen Remodel Market

Before-and-after galleries, project videos, and detailed case pages show the quality behind your pricing. Homeowners who see that work first push back less on the quote.

Consistent, High-Quality Leads

SEO keeps leads coming in slower months, and ads fill gaps when you need work fast. Together they target searches like "kitchen renovation cost" and "custom kitchen remodelers."

FAQs About Our Kitchen Remodeling Marketing Services

Kitchen remodeling marketing works best when SEO, Google Ads, and Meta Ads run together. Ads can bring in consultation requests within the first week, and SEO builds rankings that keep leads coming over 6 to 12 months. Comparing agencies first? See kitchen remodeling lead generation agencies compared .

 Most homeowners search online before they call a kitchen remodeling company. SEO puts you in local results, Google Ads puts you at the top today, and Meta Ads keep your projects in front of planners. Together they fill your calendar with consultations you didn’t have to chase through referrals.

 It depends on your budget, market, and close rate. Kitchen remodels are high-ticket jobs, so one extra booked project a month often covers the marketing cost.

Cost depends on which channels you need, how many cities you target, and your ad budget. A single-city SEO plan costs less than SEO plus Google Ads and Meta Ads across a metro.

The cost of digital marketing varies depending on the services you choose, your budget, and your goals.

Not always. If it’s slow or dated, a rebuild usually comes first, because ads and SEO can’t fix a site that doesn’t convert.
